WK-W1-LAB-1.title: LAB: PC Building: Computer System Assembly
WK-W1-LAB-1.algorithmIntro: This process explains how the main components of a computer system are assembled and connected in the correct order. It shows how input components, processing components, output components, and storage components are installed to create a working computer system.

Install the RAM>>1: Connect Power Supply → RAM: Line Type: Arrow Connection Line>>2: Add text: RAM Provides Temporary Working Memory for the CPU
Install the SSD>>1: Connect Power Supply → SSD: Line Type: Arrow Connection Line>>2: Add text: SSD Stores the Operating System, Programs, and Files

WK-W1-LAB-2.title: LAB: CPU:Instruction Processing
WK-W1-LAB-2.algorithmIntro: This process explains how the CPU receives, fetches, decodes, and executes a computer instruction. It shows how registers, the instruction decoder, cache, RAM, and ALU work together to process the required data. The purpose is to make the instruction-processing sequence clear from the keyboard input through CPU execution to the final result on the monitor.

Decode the Instruction>>1: Connect Registers → Instruction Decoder: Line Type: Arrow Connection Line>>2: Add text: Decoder Determines the Required Operation

Fetch Missing Data>>1: Connect Cache → RAM: Line Type: Arrow Connection Line>>2: Add text: RAM Supplies Data When It Is Not in Cache
Execute the Operation>>1: Connect RAM → ALU: Line Type: Arrow Connection Line>>2: Add text: ALU Performs the Calculation
Display the Result>>1: Connect ALU → Monitor: Line Type: Arrow Connection Line>>2: Add text: Monitor Shows the Calculated Answer

WK-W1-LAB-2.finalCheck: Keyboard → Instruction Fetch Unit → Registers → Instruction Decoder → Cache → RAM → ALU → Monitor

Cache the Data>>1: Connect RAM Module → Cache: Line Type: Arrow Connection Line>>2: Add text: Data Is Cached for Faster Future Access
Display the File>>1: Connect Cache → Monitor: Line Type: Arrow Connection Line>>2: Add text: Monitor Displays the File Contents

WK-W2-LAB-1.title: LAB: RAM: CPU Reads Data

Use the Data>>1: Connect CPU Register → CPU: Line Type: Arrow Connection Line>>2: Add text: CPU Uses the Data to Execute the Instruction

WK-W2-LAB-2.title: LAB: RAM: CPU Writes Data
WK-W2-LAB-2.algorithmIntro: This process explains how the CPU stores newly produced data in RAM. It shows how the CPU register, memory controller, memory bus, and RAM cooperate so that data is written to the correct memory location and the CPU cache is updated accordingly.

steps.title: Install the Power Supply
Load the Operating System>>1: Connect Power Supply → Operating System: Line Type: Arrow Connection Line>>2: Add text: Operating System Starts Up After Receiving Power
Execute the Instruction>>1: Connect Operating System → CPU: Line Type: Arrow Connection Line>>2: Add text: CPU Executes an Instruction That Produces Data to Store

The purpose is to trace the complete path from the CPU's request through virtual memory to the data being used.
